verses.text: Make haste, O God, to deliver me; Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.

segments.text: Make haste to help me, O Jehovah.

verses.text: Let them be put to shame and confounded That seek after my soul: Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor That delight in my hurt.

segments.text: Let them be put to shame and confounded
Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor

verses.text: Let them be turned back by reason of their shame That say, Aha, aha.

segments.text: Let them be turned back by reason of their shame

verses.text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee; And let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

segments.text: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee;
And let such as love thy salvation say continually,

verses.text: But I am poor and needy; Make haste unto me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; O Jehovah, make no tarrying.

segments.text: But I am poor and needy;
Make haste unto me, O God:
Thou art my help and my deliverer;

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David; to bring to remembrance.
